g.text: Drawn from the record: 02-PROJECTS/01-electrical/data/panel_ribbon.csv, dcu_channels SN18-SN20, D-380. Where this sheet and a row disagree, the row is right.

g.text: No processor, no CAN node, no 12 V on the ribbon (D-355, D-380); +5 V and I2C for the lights only (D-458). Key positions and looks are the faceplate (luxury LP20) - not on this sheet.

g.desc: No processor, no CAN node, no 12 V on the ribbon (D-355, D-380); +5 V and I2C for the lights only (D-458). Key positions and looks are the faceplate (luxury LP20) - not on this sheet.

g.text: R11: nothing here has been measured; the thumbstick (P156) and the key switches are not chosen. Rev 0.02 (Y6): footprints, both key styles. Rev 0.03 (D-458, D-459): 26-way ribbon, IS31FL3236A, 35 LEDs.

g.text: ROW3 x COL2 window PASS up

g.desc: ROW3 x COL2 window PASS up

g.text: 22 kHz PWM (register 4Bh) keeps the ceramic caps silent (p.12). SDB held high by R2: powers up blank (p.9).

g.desc: 22 kHz PWM (register 4Bh) keeps the ceramic caps silent (p.12). SDB held high by R2: powers up blank (p.9).

g.text: One channel per LED; R1 10k sets IMAX = 58.5 x 1.3 V / 10k = 7.6 mA (p.11); 256 PWM steps per channel.

g.desc: One channel per LED; R1 10k sets IMAX = 58.5 x 1.3 V / 10k = 7.6 mA (p.11); 256 PWM steps per channel.

g.text: IS31FL3236A-TQLS4 (eTQFP-48, -40 to +125 C) on the back, I2C 0x3C (AD to GND), on the DCU's bus:

g.desc: IS31FL3236A-TQLS4 (eTQFP-48, -40 to +125 C) on the back, I2C 0x3C (AD to GND), on the DCU's bus:

g.text: Ribbon to the DCU - 26-way 2.54 mm IDC box header, keyed, panel end (P157, panel_ribbon, D-458): 1-20 as before, 21 GND, 22 PNL_SDA, 23 GND, 24 PNL_SCL, 25 SPARE, 26 +5V_PNL

g.desc: Ribbon to the DCU - 26-way 2.54 mm IDC box header, keyed, panel end (P157, panel_ribbon, D-458): 1-20 as before, 21 GND, 22 PNL_SDA, 23 GND, 24 PNL_SCL, 25 SPARE, 26 +5V_PNL

g.desc: ROW3 x COL1 window DRV down

g.text: illumination in (DNP) - its own lead from L3-S1 8 (DV53, PV94): only for the style-(b) rings; the panel LEDs dim over I2C (D-462)

g.desc: illumination in (DNP) - its own lead from L3-S1 8 (DV53, PV94): only for the style-(b) rings; the panel LEDs dim over I2C (D-462)

g.text: driver seat: cw heat 1-3, ccw cool 1-3

g.desc: driver seat: cw heat 1-3, ccw cool 1-3

g.text: OUT1-9 keys in 0x400 bit order, OUT10-16 fan, OUT17-23 temperature, OUT24-29 driver seat, OUT30-35 passenger seat, OUT36 open.

g.desc: OUT1-9 keys in 0x400 bit order, OUT10-16 fan, OUT17-23 temperature, OUT24-29 driver seat, OUT30-35 passenger seat, OUT36 open.

g.text: Dimming (D-462): the DCU scales every channel's PWM to the dash dimmer level and writes the update register 25h;

g.desc: Dimming (D-462): the DCU scales every channel's PWM to the dash dimmer level and writes the update register 25h;

g.text: 0x74 / 0x75 (expanders, SN17) and 0x48 (ADC, SN29) are the carrier's. +5V_PNL from ribbon pin 26 (PTC F1 on the carrier).

g.desc: 0x74 / 0x75 (expanders, SN17) and 0x48 (ADC, SN29) are the carrier's. +5V_PNL from ribbon pin 26 (PTC F1 on the carrier).

g.text: - Both key styles are drawn (SWn fitted, SWBn DNP); encoder and stick parts are confirm until V-113 and LP20.

g.desc: - Both key styles are drawn (SWn fitted, SWBn DNP); encoder and stick parts are confirm until V-113 and LP20.

g.text: - The lights (D-458): LED colours, the 7.6 mA ceiling (R1) and the window positions are confirm until LP20 and the bench.

g.desc: - The lights (D-458): LED colours, the 7.6 mA ceiling (R1) and the window positions are confirm until LP20 and the bench.

g.text: - ILLUM_12V / ILLUM_GND (J2, DNP) feed only the style-(b) light rings: J2 is fitted with SWB1-9 if 03.14 is (b).

g.desc: - ILLUM_12V / ILLUM_GND (J2, DNP) feed only the style-(b) light rings: J2 is fitted with SWB1-9 if 03.14 is (b).

g.text: KEY STYLE (b) - ALTERNATES, DNP: a 12-16 mm round button with a light ring, wired to the board on a 4-way JST-XH (luxury 03.14 open)

g.desc: KEY STYLE (b) - ALTERNATES, DNP: a 12-16 mm round button with a light ring, wired to the board on a 4-way JST-XH (luxury 03.14 open)

g.text: Each SWBn sits in parallel with SWn on the same column and diode: fit SW1-SW9 (style a, recommended) or SWB1-SWB9 (style b), never both. Ring LED 3-4 across the illumination input; a 12 V ring with its own resistor - confirm.

g.desc: Each SWBn sits in parallel with SWn on the same column and diode: fit SW1-SW9 (style a, recommended) or SWB1-SWB9 (style b), never both. Ring LED 3-4 across the illumination input; a 12 V ring with its own resistor - confirm.

g.text: LIGHTS (D-458) - 35 LEDs on the faceplate side, anode +5V_PNL, cathode to one IS31FL3236A channel each (OUT1-OUT35, OUT36 spare)

g.desc: LIGHTS (D-458) - 35 LEDs on the faceplate side, anode +5V_PNL, cathode to one IS31FL3236A channel each (OUT1-OUT35, OUT36 spare)

g.text: A key's LED sits by its key; each knob has an arc of LEDs over it: fan and temperature 7 steps, each seat cool 3-2-1 | OFF | heat 1-2-3. Windows: panel/README.md. Colours and currents are LP20's and the bench's - confirm.

g.desc: A key's LED sits by its key; each knob has an arc of LEDs over it: fan and temperature 7 steps, each seat cool 3-2-1 | OFF | heat 1-2-3. Windows: panel/README.md. Colours and currents are LP20's and the bench's - confirm.

g.text: - AGND is its own ribbon conductor (pin 20), joined to GND only at the DCU carrier.

g.desc: - AGND is its own ribbon conductor (pin 20), joined to GND only at the DCU carrier.
